title: GeoCAM: Self-Supervised Sonar-Optical Representation Learning via Geographic Overlap Supervision
abstract: arXiv:2611.34218v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Cross-modal self-supervised learning for paired side-scan sonar and underwater optical imagery is a promising direction for benthic habitat understanding, but it remains underexplored because existing methods do not fully exploit the one-to-many correspondences and geographic metadata available in real opti-acoustic surveys. This limits the ability to learn representations that are both semantically meaningful and geometrically consistent from abundant unlabeled marine data. To address this problem, we present GeoCAM, a geography-guided framework that learns a shared embedding space for sonar tiles and their associated optical views without semantic annotations. translated_title: GeoCAM：基于地理重叠监督的自监督声呐-光学表示学习
translated_abstract: 针对配对的侧扫声呐与水下光学图像的跨模态自监督学习，是海底栖息地理解的一个有前景的方向，但由于现有方法未能充分利用真实光学-声学勘测中可用的一对多对应关系和地理元数据，该方向仍未被充分探索。这限制了从大量无标注海洋数据中学习兼具语义意义和几何一致性的表示的能力。为解决这一问题，我们提出了GeoCAM，一个地理引导的框架，它无需语义标注即可为声呐图像瓦片及其关联的光学视图学习共享嵌入空间。GeoCAM通过结合三个组件来实现其目标：(i) 一个集合注意力聚合器，能够自适应地将多个光学观测汇总为单一的瓦片级表示；(ii) 一个几何加权InfoNCE目标函数，将GPS导出的足迹重叠转换为……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: GeoCAM提出了一种地理引导的自监督学习框架，利用GPS足迹重叠信息作为监督信号，结合集合注意力聚合器和几何加权InfoNCE目标，在无需语义标注的情况下为侧扫声呐图像与水下光学图像学习共享的跨模态嵌入表示。
en_tdlr: GeoCAM is a geography-guided self-supervised framework that uses GPS-derived footprint overlap as supervision, combining a Set Attention Aggregator with a geometry-weighted InfoNCE objective to learn a shared cross-modal embedding space for side-scan sonar tiles and underwater optical views without semantic annotations.
